Hi Thomas,

Thank you for being fair about it, and you're right about the updates. You shouldn't have had to ask us. That's on us, not on you.

On the Magic Miner 40T on Shop····: nothing has left yet, Magic Miner expects the units to ship out from the factory on November 12, and your tracking goes out by email the moment your miner ships to you. Our partner from Harlo Labs visits the factory on Thursday November 5 and we'll have new photos and video from there. You'll hear from us when there is news, without having to write first.

On Shop····, the KBeast: the order is paid, nothing has shipped, and the warehouse side is already stopped, so there is no risk of it going out. The money side is not mine to move, so I've put it straight in front of Abel and Georges with your question about the delay. The team is on right now and a colleague is picking it up today, and they'll confirm the amount and the timing directly in this thread.

Sorry again for the chasing, Thomas.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support
